title: Viz Media Licenses Kyousuke Motomi's Registry of the Divine Manga
content: Viz Media announced on Wednesday that it has licensed Kyousuke Motomi 's Registry of the Divine ( Yaoyoruzu Toriatsukai Setsumeisho ) manga and will begin releasing it in English on the Viz Manga app on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Rei Mikamoto Ends Blood Friend Manga in December
content: The December issue of Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Beam magazine announced on Thursday that Rei Mikamoto will end the Blood Friend manga in the next issue on December 11. The violent horror manga is set in an old western-style mansion rumored to be haunted, on the outskirts of a town.
author: ANN

title: Duel Masters GT Manga's Part 3 Ends
content: Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic manga released the final chapter of Hiroki Kikuzuma and Daisuke Kawasaki 's Duel Masters GT3 -Glitch of the Twin heart- , the third part of their Duel Masters GT manga, in early access on Wednesday. The chapter will release publicly on November 18.
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online Creator’s New Anime Has a Much Better First Impression
content: The creator behind Sword Art Online has a new anime now airing its episodes through the Fall, and a new update has revealed just how long Devils’ Crest is going to be sticking around for.
author: ComicBook

title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Anime Casts Yūsuke Kobayashi
content: The staff for the television anime of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga announced on Thursday that Yūsuke Kobayashi is joining the anime's cast as a "mysterious boy" who has an equally mysterious plan for the seven knight brothers.
author: ANN

title: Here’s What’s Leaving HIDIVE in November 2026
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is only a month away, and it’s going to be another exciting quarter for fans. With the return of major shows such as Black Clover and The Apothecary Diaries , the schedule is already packed, and more will be announced at a later date.
author: ComicBook

title: Welsh & Shedar Anime Launches Webtoon
content: French entertainment company Ankama announced on Wednesday that a 12-episode webtoon adaptation of the original television anime Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar ) launched on Ankama 's own French comic platform Allskreen and the Ankama Launcher portal app on the same day.
author: ANN

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Film Opens at #1 in Japan, Grotesqqque Anime Film at #8
content: Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , ranked at #1 in its first weekend. The film sold 699,000 tickets and earned 1,130,171,300 yen (about US$7.11 million) over the November 6-8 weekend.
author: ANN
